Project.Name: AEGIS - PDD and Project Plan TEMPLATE
Project.Title: AEGIS - AI-assisted condition monitoring of a Niryo One
Project.Author: Reece Herbert

Task.Name: Project definition and PDD
Task.Notes: EDITABLE TEMPLATE. Example start: 28 September 2026. Dates are not university deadlines. Standard 8-hour weekday calendar, no holidays entered. Me is assigned at 25% (about 2 project hours per working day); durations are working-day windows. All completion values are placeholders (0%), including existing work. Add term breaks, availability and official deadlines before baselining. Review the interim-review position. Maintain references, lab notes, backups and risk updates throughout. Automatic robot stop/slow is optional and excluded from the core schedule. XML structure and links validated; desktop import has not been tested here.

Task.Name: Review PDD guidance and confirm submission dates
Task.Notes: Confirm actual PDD, interim review, final report and demonstration deadlines with supervisor; all dates here are examples.

Task.Name: Define rationale, benefits and intended users
Task.Notes: Explain why AI-assisted robotic-arm condition monitoring is worthwhile.

Task.Name: Define primary aims, scope and deliverables
Task.Notes: Niryo One telemetry, SQLite logging, anomaly detection and monitoring interface. Keep automatic safety response optional.

Task.Name: Define secondary aims and measurable success criteria
Task.Notes: Agree measurable data completeness, repeatability, false-alarm rate and detection performance targets before experiments.

Task.Name: Plan methodology, experiments and evaluation
Task.Notes: Simulation first, then real-arm baseline collection; compare a simple threshold baseline with anomaly detection.

Task.Name: Assess risks, constraints, ethics and legal issues
Task.Notes: Include robot access, compatibility, data loss, procurement delays, safe experiments, data handling and software licences.

Task.Name: Estimate costs, resources and commercial context
Task.Notes: Itemised hardware budget, existing equipment, potential users and competing approaches; no costs assumed.

Task.Name: Draft PDD and review Gantt with supervisor
Task.Notes: The supplied guidance says the PDD is standalone and does not require a significant literature review.

Task.Name: PDD ready for submission - placeholder milestone
Task.Notes: Replace with the official deadline; this is a planned readiness milestone.

Task.Name: Research
Review condition monitoring and anomaly detection literature
Task.Notes: Maintain references and justify methods; refresh literature at later review checkpoints.

Task.Name: Investigate Niryo One ROS1 telemetry and connectivity
Task.Notes: Confirm available joint states, temperature/current fields and error/status topics. Do not assume all measurements are available.

Task.Name: Research sensors, sampling and data quality
Task.Notes: Compare vibration, temperature and current sensing; distinguish measured data from estimates.

Task.Name: Compare architecture and detection methods
Task.Notes: Python, MQTT, Node-RED and SQLite; review simple baselines and suitable unsupervised methods.

Task.Name: Research findings and feasibility reviewed
Task.Notes: Record decisions and unresolved risks.

Task.Name: Design
Define system architecture and data flow
Task.Notes: Niryo One / optional sensors -> Python collection -> SQLite; MQTT and Node-RED added during integration.

Task.Name: Design database schema and logging contract
Task.Notes: Runs, timestamped telemetry, units, source identifiers, errors, stops and run metadata.

Task.Name: Design dashboard and digital monitoring view
Task.Notes: Robot state, joint telemetry, motor health where available, anomaly score, history and database status.

Task.Name: Design experiments and test acceptance criteria
Task.Notes: Define repeatable motions, train/test split by run, thresholds, baselines and safe fault surrogates.

Task.Name: Design review and scope approval
Task.Notes: Freeze minimum deliverables; retain optional items in a backlog.

Task.Name: Buying hardware
Confirm bill of materials, compatibility and budget
Task.Notes: Only purchase sensors and interfaces required by the approved design; Arduino/ESP32 choice remains editable.

Task.Name: Obtain purchasing approval and place orders
Task.Notes: Placeholder planning task; no purchase has been made.

Task.Name: Supplier delivery lead time
Task.Notes: Waiting time; no work resource assigned. Replace with supplier estimate.

Task.Name: Inspect received hardware and check connections
Task.Notes: Verify correct components, voltage compatibility and safe mounting.

Task.Name: Simulations
Review existing PyBullet prototype and reproduce baseline
Task.Notes: Existing simulation work is acknowledged; this task verifies and documents it rather than assuming it starts from zero.

Task.Name: Extend repeatable trajectories and telemetry logging
Task.Notes: Record positions, errors and simulated health indicators with units and run metadata.

Task.Name: Implement simulated fault scenarios
Task.Notes: Friction, blockage and related disturbances in simulation; simulated current/temperature must be labelled as estimates.

Task.Name: Run simulation experiments and inspect SQLite results
Task.Notes: Verify repeatability, timestamps, labels and per-run summaries.

Task.Name: Simulation evidence reviewed
Task.Notes: Document the simulation-to-real limitations.

Task.Name: Prototypes
Verify Niryo One connection, telemetry and safe operation
Task.Notes: Resolve Studio/ROS1 compatibility and inspect available topics before experiments.

Task.Name: Prototype real-arm telemetry capture to SQLite
Task.Notes: Collect joint positions, reported errors/stops and communication events alongside Niryo Studio.

Task.Name: Run and inspect a 30-minute normal-data collection
Task.Notes: Check completeness, timestamps and queryability. Record missing signals explicitly.

Task.Name: Prototype external sensor acquisition and mounting
Task.Notes: Use approved hardware; bench-test before attaching to the robot.

Task.Name: Prototype feasibility review
Task.Notes: Confirm physical-arm access; document any fallback and scope changes with supervisor.

Task.Name: Coding
Harden collector, database logging and reconnect handling
Task.Notes: Handle disconnects, timestamp consistency and duplicate/missing samples.

Task.Name: Implement preprocessing and sensor synchronisation
Task.Notes: Preserve raw data; align sources and calculate documented features.

Task.Name: Implement threshold baseline and anomaly detector
Task.Notes: Fit preprocessing and models only on training runs; retain separate evaluation runs.

Task.Name: Implement MQTT and Node-RED monitoring interface
Task.Notes: Show status, telemetry, anomaly outputs, history and logging health.

Task.Name: Integrate components and document configuration
Task.Notes: Create reproducible start-up instructions and versioned settings.

Task.Name: Integrated AEGIS prototype ready
Task.Notes: Minimum monitoring pipeline available for testing.

Task.Name: Interim review and research update
Update literature, decisions and risk register
Task.Notes: Review new evidence and explain departures from the initial plan.

Task.Name: Prepare interim review and demonstrate progress
Task.Notes: Placeholder timing: move this phase to the official interim-review date.

Task.Name: Interim review complete - placeholder milestone
Task.Notes: Record supervisor feedback and actions.

Task.Name: Testing
Verify logging, database queries and dashboard behaviour
Task.Notes: Test missing data, connection loss, restarts and status reporting.

Task.Name: Collect repeated normal-operation datasets
Task.Notes: Vary permitted operating conditions and keep complete run metadata.

Task.Name: Conduct approved anomaly and fault-surrogate experiments
Task.Notes: Use simulation for blocked joints/overload unless a safe physical protocol is specifically approved; do not deliberately damage the arm.

Task.Name: Evaluate detection and compare with baseline
Task.Notes: Use held-out runs; report false alarms, detection delay and precision/recall where reliable labels exist.

Task.Name: Fix defects and rerun affected tests
Task.Notes: Maintain a defect log and repeat the relevant checks.

Task.Name: Testing evidence complete
Task.Notes: Archive datasets, results and known limitations.

Task.Name: Evaluation and contingency
Evaluate aims, costs, limitations and practical value
Task.Notes: Assess success against the criteria agreed in the PDD; distinguish simulated from real-world evidence.

Task.Name: Contingency for access, hardware or integration delays
Task.Notes: Explicit schedule reserve; reduce or move only after reviewing risks.

Task.Name: Final technical review
Task.Notes: Confirm evidence supports the conclusions and remaining issues are documented.

Task.Name: Report writing and submission
Consolidate ongoing research and implementation notes
Task.Notes: Keep notes throughout earlier tasks; this phase consolidates them.

Task.Name: Write methodology, design and implementation chapters
Task.Notes: Explain justified technical choices and reproducibility.

Task.Name: Write results, discussion, conclusions and reflection
Task.Notes: Compare outcomes to aims and explain changes from the PDD.

Task.Name: Review references, figures, appendices and formatting
Task.Notes: Check attribution, captions, units and submission requirements.

Task.Name: Supervisor feedback and final revisions
Task.Notes: Allow for supervisor availability; agree review arrangements.

Task.Name: Final report ready - placeholder milestone
Task.Notes: Replace with the official submission deadline.

Task.Name: Demonstration and handover
Prepare demonstration, presentation and backup recording
Task.Notes: Show telemetry capture, anomaly output and stored evidence.

Task.Name: Archive code, datasets, instructions and final evidence
Task.Notes: Verify restore/reproduction instructions; preserve raw datasets.

Task.Name: Project complete - placeholder milestone
Task.Notes: Confirm official assessment and handover requirements.
